test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence.

Food spoliage refers to an irreversible modification in which food becomes inedible or its quality is compromised.
solution:
The correct answer is** Spoliage.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here the correct word is ***Spoilage ***in the given sentence:

__
 
• Food *spoliage *refers to an irreversible modification in which food becomes inedible or its quality is compromised.​
 
• **Spoilage** refers to the process in which food or other substances stop being good enough to eat or use, or the waste produced in this process

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here we will see the meaning of the other given words:

 
• **Irreversible - **not possible to change; impossible to return to a previous condition

 
 
• ***Eg.*** Smoking has caused irreversible damage to his lungs.
 
 
 
• **Modification **- a change to something, usually to improve it:
 
 
• ***Eg***. Modification of the engine to run on lead-free fuel is fairly simple.
 
 
 
• **Inedible - **not suitable or good enough to eat:
 
 
• ***Eg***. The dish was too spicy, and inedible as a result.
